Daily Devotional

November 18

17 But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit. (1 Corinthians 6:17 KJV)

Paul is saying that the same way that a physical union comes from sexual relationships, our spiritual union with God comes from our relationship with God. We are truly one with God in the Spirit, and we have been given the very Spirit of Jesus to live in us (Galatians 4:6). Since Jesus had the whole Godhead living within Him that means that we have the fullness of God living in us, if we are born again Christians. If you don’t think you have the Spirit of Jesus living in you, then you are not born again, or are ignorant of the fact (Romans 8:9). Since us humans can not detect the spirit with our five physical senses, it is hard for us to know that we have a spirit. You must know it is there by faith that the Word of God is true, not by feeling it. You also know you have the Spirit of Christ living in you by the fruit that it produces in the way you want to live for Him.

If we believers could just realize what this means, that we have the Spirit of Christ living in us, then we would know that we have the power that raised Christ from the grave available to us (Romans 8:11), if we can just have the faith to make use of it. All it takes to release that power is faith, and with faith we can be healed, delivered, prospered, as well as have our sins forgiven. It is faith that pleases God (Hebrews 11:6), and it is faith that unlocks all the Spiritual Gifts that God has bestowed upon us by Grace. We also have the mind of Christ in our New Spirits (1 Corinthians 2:16), and if you have the Holy Ghost living in you, you can even release that knowledge by speaking in tongues and praying to interpret it. Thank you Jesus for bringing us all these Gifts, and thank you Father for your plan of redemption, and bringing us back into relationship with You. What an honor it is to be called the Sons of God – WOW!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
